name: r4-q4-gen2-blob-tz-text
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 B2): a copy of 07I-gen2-fixed-transition.json with the fixed WEEKLY schedule's timezone stored as CAST('Asia/Tokyo' AS BLOB). push.js resolvedClockTimezone is String(schedule.timezone || fallback || 'UTC') and fixedScheduleSnapshot writes clock_timezone: String(that || 'UTC'), so the transition's source_schedule_snapshot holds the decoded text (an empty Buffer becomes 'UTC'), while each schedule entry keeps the Buffer.

steps.why: devices discovered and claimed before the session, as in the release smoke

steps.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS q4_typeof; CREATE TABLE q4_typeof AS SELECT 'zones' AS source, id, typeof(timezone) AS class, hex(timezone) AS bytes FROM irrigation_zones UNION ALL SELECT 'schedules', id, typeof(timezone), hex(timezone) FROM valve_schedules
